$comment: prioritize_sites (server/ask/prioritize.mjs). Presets are weight sets over normalised criteria (0 = least urgent among the candidates, 1 = most). The same data gives each stakeholder its own order; switching preset shows how far each site moves and why. Weighted sum, not TOPSIS, so each contribution is explainable. No SLA or safety pins yet: the twin holds no response-time targets.

criteria.fifo: Age of the oldest open work order (days): first in, first out
criteria.distance: Distance from the depot (km): closer is sooner
criteria.inspection: Worst ITS inspection risk rating (1-5) in the last 3 inspections
criteria.priority: Highest open work-order priority (High 3, Medium 2, Low 1)
criteria.revenue: Toll revenue at risk per day while the camera is down (needs Tolling & revenue)

siteRevenue.$comment: SYNTHETIC demo authoring. Which toll gantry each camera's images support, and what share of that gantry's image-dependent revenue is lost while the camera is down. The three cameras are traffic CCTV, not toll plate cameras: these links stand in for the real camera-to-gantry dependency an agency would supply. Revenue at risk/day = average daily image-dependent revenue of the gantry x share x unrecoverableFraction.
